answer: A workable design: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The fable of work and the nebula of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a karst to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
